frei.cosmetic: A little something for the wardrobe

log.leer: Nothing to do right now — the ranch is at rest. Enjoy it, it never lasts.

warte.notify_fertig: {quest} is ready — come take a look!
warte.activity_laeuft: Something is happening at the ranch …
warte.alternative_1: The horses would love a grooming round.
warte.alternative_2: Timmi is probably hunting for a horseshoe right now. Or twelve.
warte.alternative_3: Marta supposedly has the last piece on offer. Again.
warte.alternative_4: The photo spot at the pond has wonderful light right now.

haupt_01.text: The ranch is here, you are here — only the shine is missing. Rosi has a plan and you have two hands. That's called destiny.

haupt_02.text: Wilma says a rancher without a horse is like a stable without hay: theoretically possible, practically sad. Time for your first own horse.

haupt_03.text: Marta insists you meet everyone in the valley. Not out of politeness — she wants to know firsthand what people are saying about you.

haupt_04.text: Selma is stitching you a custom saddle. The prototype looked like a potato, hence the name. Good work needs wool, patience and a blacksmith for the fittings.

haupt_05.text: Your first tournament! Mr. Punktabzug promises fair judging and at least one deduction. On principle. Show him posture.

haupt_06.text: Luna whispers of an old wild horse with a forged hoof. Whoever wants to see it needs soft steps and a little patience at dawn.

haupt_07.text: Eilfried has a letter that may only be delivered at night. From whom? To whom? The answer waits at the pond — after a very mysterious waiting period.

haupt_08.text: A foal is on its way in the stable! Dr. Dr. Möhrchen prescribes: good feed, rest, and two days of NO singing. The singing part is negotiable. Not.

haupt_09.text: Knips is planning his exhibition: The Ranch Awakens. All that's missing are the final shots — and someone to walk through the valley's most beautiful light for them. You.

haupt_10.text: Everything has led to this: garlands, guests, one last tournament — and a photo Knips has waited years for. The whole ranch. One table. Everyone.

neben_rosi_1.text: Rosi swears the muck multiplies at night. She keeps a tally. Prove her wrong — with the pitchfork.

neben_rosi_2.text: Five old horseshoes for Rosi's lucky wall. She says you can nail down luck. The wall says nothing, it's a wall.

neben_rosi_saat.text: Rosi is secretly planting flowers behind the pasture. For nobody. Just because. Help with the sowing and tell NO ONE — especially not Marta.

neben_moehrchen_1.text: Dr. Dr. Möhrchen prescribes three grooming sessions. Against what? Against scruffy coats and bad moods. Works on horse AND rancher.

neben_moehrchen_2.text: The practice has been eaten empty! Six carrots, urgently. Otherwise the patients get restless. So does the doctor. Especially the doctor.

neben_eisenhuf_1.text: Eisenhuf is forging you a special piece. He needs an hour and absolute quiet. Come back when the sparks are asleep.

neben_eisenhuf_2.text: Four hooves need care. Eisenhuf shows you the grip, you do the work. That's how apprenticeship works. He says. Grinning.

neben_selma_1.text: Selma needs measurements for her secret project — but it has to stay a surprise. Question people without revealing why. Inconspicuously. So: good luck.

neben_selma_2.text: The new saddle needs to settle. Four hours of patience, then a test lap. Meanwhile Selma stitches holes into thin air. Out of nervousness.

neben_wilma_1.text: Count Gallop requests apples. Three of them, polished, served core-free. Wilma appoints you court supplier. It is an honor. Says the Count. Via snorting.

neben_wilma_2.text: Wilma tells the story of the bee race — but the second half only comes on your second visit. Dramaturgy, she says. Aristocratic series production.

neben_punktabzug_1.text: Before the competition comes the practice. Mr. Punktabzug is watching. He also grades your practice. Of course he grades your practice.

neben_punktabzug_2.text: Onto the podium! Third place is enough — but the posture must be flawless. The judge sees everything. Even with his eyes closed, he claims.

neben_timmi_1.text: Timmi has a secret he ABSOLUTELY must show you at the paddock. It's a rock that looks like a horse. It is the best rock in the world.

neben_timmi_2.text: Timmi is building a stable for Lightning, his stick horse. Lightning doesn't need a stable. Lightning gets a stable. Four planks, please!

neben_alwin_1.text: Alwin tells you the drought story. Listen to it three times — it grows a year longer each telling. That's not a weakness, that's craftsmanship.

neben_alwin_2.text: Somewhere in the hay storage lies the key to Alwin's old chest. He's been looking for it for years. Meaning: he sits next to it and you look.

neben_luna_1.text: Luna wants to teach you the quiet walk. First to the forest edge, then up the hill. If the birds stay put, you've passed.

neben_luna_2.text: Trust exercise: pat three animals so gently they barely notice. Barely. They should notice a little. It's complicated and beautiful.

neben_marta_1.text: Marta is launching an ad campaign for Kurt, the crooked pumpkin. Spread the word! Kurt remains unsellable anyway. It's about the principle.

neben_marta_2.text: Five berries, plump and glossy. Officially for the stall. Unofficially Marta eats them immediately herself. You get jam in return. The circle of life.

neben_eilfried_1.text: Eilfried has you walk his round: gate, market, pond. He wants to know how long legs take. For the statistics. And not really for his ego.

neben_eilfried_2.text: You sent a pen-pal request to the neighboring valley. The reply comes with the morning mail. Eilfried keeps his fingers crossed. Ducks have no fingers. He crosses them anyway.

neben_knips_1.text: Knips swears: the subject of the year is waiting at the pond. Stand there, hold still and smile. The subject is you, by the way. Surprise.

neben_knips_2.text: Everyone should smile once for the portrait series. Your job: tell them Knips is NOT taking pictures. Then everyone looks natural. He is of course taking pictures.

neben_miez_1.text: Miez requests wool. Two skeins, delivered to the house, onto the soft cushion. She will not say thank you. She will purr. That is worth more.

neben_miez_2.text: Miez cannot possibly inspect today (sleeping shift three of five). Walk her round: hay storage, then trough. Report irregularities. There never are any. Report anyway.

tages_ausmisten.text: One round of mucking out, please. The stable thanks you. So does your nose.

tages_aepfel.text: Two apples for the practice. An apple a day … you know the saying. Dr. Dr. Möhrchen had it patented.

tages_seerunde.text: Once around the lake, wind in the mane. Wilma calls it a constitutional gallop. The horses call it the best part of the day.

tages_striegeln.text: One grooming round until the coat shines. Rosi checks with her mirror gaze. The mirror gaze is notorious.

tages_plausch.text: Marta and Eilfried are trading news — about you. Go join in, then at least the facts will be halfway right.

tages_fotospot.text: Knips reports: perfect light at the hill spot! Run over and see it before the sun changes its mind.
